ranked_facts.concept_key: depressed, alopecic patches on the scalp
ranked_facts.why: depressed, alopecic patches are more typical of discoid lupus erythematosus

ranked_facts.concept_key: inflammatory infiltrates between adipocytes with hyaline fat necrosis
ranked_facts.why: inflammatory infiltrates with hyaline fat necrosis are characteristic of lupus erythematosus

fact_rationales.F10: The presence of curved-line, depressed, alopecic patches is consistent with discoid lupus erythematosus and other scalp conditions.
fact_rationales.F17: The histopathologic finding of lymphocytic infiltrates and lobular panniculitis is highly suggestive of discoid lupus erythematosus.
fact_rationales.F19: The positive direct immunofluorescence with granular deposition of IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q, and fibrinogen in the dermal blood vessels is highly suggestive of discoid lupus erythematosus.
fact_rationales.F3: Localized linear hair loss is consistent with several scalp conditions, including discoid lupus erythematosus and lichen planopilaris.
